note: Private family resort on a whitetail-deer ranch near Sabetha with RV loops under trees along Pony Creek, a stocked catch-and-release fishing pond, petting zoo and Kansas's largest wooden-floor roller rink (closed Sundays); mini-golf, splash pad and courts on a $12 daily activity pass. The operator warns not to follow GPS routing, which uses gravel roads. --Claude
summary: Operator site + RoverPass engine: $30-60 nightly (electric only $30 weekday), 30/50 A full hookups, rigs to 55 ft, open May 1-Nov 1, instant RoverPass booking. Google 4.8/144 with phone 785-285-8800 (stored entry has none). Not waterfront kept (creek bottom under canopy).
flags: PHONE (apply.py does not write it): add 785-285-8800, on the operator's site, RoverPass and Google Maps. The entry has no phone now.
WEBSITE: stored https://sycamorespringswhitetails.com confirmed live (operator, GoDaddy site).

PRIVATE GATE FACTS: cheapest RV night $30 (Electric Only, Tue 2027-06-08 on the operator's RoverPass engine; $33 Saturdays; total $34.59 with booking/processing fees, no tax shown). The operator pages disagree among themselves ($30/$45/$50 on the home page, $30/$40/$50 on the activity page, $33/$44/$55/$66 on the camping page); the engine is the live figure. Under $50; gateways.py none within 40 km (moot). Presence passes: working website + phone, Google 4.8 from 144 reviews. RV Life 4.5, $$.

ENTRY FEES: the $12/person Daily Activity Pass is for the park's activities (rink, mini-golf, etc.) and does not appear in the RoverPass quote; nothing says campers must buy it, so it is not counted toward the nightly rate. Weakly read: no page says outright that it is optional.

LONG-STAY: weekly $300, monthly $850 and 6-month 'Season Rate' $3,000 (cement-patio sites $4,200) are sold. Test 1: no sites are said to be seasonal-only, and every RV rate books nightly; test 2: nightly rates posted and instantly bookable; test 3: no lots for sale; test 4: share of seasonals unknown, but 90 RV sites were open for a June 2027 night; test 5: no approval rule. A family activity resort, not long-stay in character.

SITES: camping page says 'Camping 120 sites'; the RoverPass engine lists 90 RV sites (plus primitive/tent). Count not written. Some Oak T-sites are grass-pad 'HOBO camping' areas; Electric Only includes 20 A sites of 20 ft, but most sites are 30-55 ft.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Pony Creek runs through the wooded creek bottom, far narrower than ~30 m, and the sites are under canopy; the 'new fishing pond' is not visible in Esri imagery and its acreage is unknown (any pond under ~5 acres earns nothing anyway; a pond-view value does not exist).

PIN: stored 39.9618,-95.7501 is at the entrance on Bittersweet Rd (Google 39.96177,-95.75009); the RV loops start ~50 m east and spread ~400 m east along the creek, so the centroid is roughly 39.9612,-95.7480 (~200 m), under the 250 m threshold. Fine.
ACCESS: operator warns GPS routes use gravel roads; follow the posted directions.
